name: Adductor Rock-Back

instructions.description: Start on all fours and extend one leg straight out to the side with the foot flat or toes up.
Keep your spine long and hands under your shoulders.
Slowly rock your hips back toward the heel of the bent leg until you feel a stretch in the inner thigh of the straight leg.
Return forward and repeat before switching sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Perform slow mobility repetitions on each side.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Stretch both inner thighs at once in a seated position.

commentsNotes: Do not force the hips backward if the back rounds excessively.
Move only through a comfortable range.
